ownership_rule: The captions database of this computer (data/qnc-shot-captions.db), outside every project: the AI agents are an add-on and their growing data is not put into the project database. qnc.module.shot-captions is its only writer.

rules.caption: A row a model and a shot (its project's public URI, clip and frames): the sentence the model wrote of what the shot shows.
rules.replace: A shot captioned again by the same model replaces its caption.
